candidates.change_summary: Replace the initialization guard to allow setting MinSum only when already initialized (reverses condition), changing whether SetMinSum can update MinSum after Initialized() is called.
Remove the revert guard so SetMinSum can always set MinSum regardless of initialization state.
Change the guard to only allow setting MinSum when not initialized and also ensure nonzero value, preventing MinSum being set to zero when allowed.

Move assignment before the guard so MinSum is set even when intitalized is true (guard then reverts but after assignment, leaving changed state when revert is not triggered due to gas; note revert will still undo so behavior differs when intitalized==true).
Invert the guard to revert only when not initialized, allowing SetMinSum only after Initialized() has been called.
Replace the body to set MinSum regardless of intitalized guard (remove the revert check) so SetMinSum can change MinSum after initialization.
Invert the initialized check so SetMinSum only sets MinSum when intitalized is true (previously it was allowed only when false).
Change assignment to add to existing MinSum instead of overwriting it, so successive calls accumulate.
Negate the provided value before assignment so MinSum is set to the two's-complement (uint cast) of _val, altering observable value.
Set MinSum to a constant (zero) regardless of input, changing observed stored value after call.
Replaced the revert-on-initialized check with an unconditional assignment so SetLogFile always sets Log even if intitalized is true.
Negated the condition so it only sets Log when already initialized (opposite behavior of original guard).
Added assignment to an alternative (incorrect) storage variable so SetLogFile writes to MinSum instead of Log, changing the observable Log value indirectly (Log remains unchanged).
Moved the revert check to after the assignment so SetLogFile assigns Log and then reverts when initialized, making the call always revert when initialized but still observable when not initialized.
Inserted a second assignment overwriting the provided _log with the zero address, so SetLogFile always sets Log to address(0) when called.
Replace updating unlockTime to use _lockTime directly instead of block.timestamp+_lockTime, causing unlockTime to store a relative duration rather than absolute timestamp.
Replace the require that checks arithmetic overflow on lockTime with a no-op true require, removing block.timestamp-based validation and allowing arbitrary _lockTime values.
Replace the balance accumulation to reset the holder balance to msg.value (dropping prior balance), changing resulting balance after Put.
Replace the call to Log.AddMessage with no call, removing the logging side-effect executed during Put.
Replace the conditional that sets unlockTime to instead always set unlockTime to block.timestamp+_lockTime, possibly decreasing it.
